# Stage 3 recon — zoom, cursor, background, frames, output (OpenScreen v2.1.2 → Inspector Rust)

Read-only. Nothing in the clone was executed. Path prefixes:
- `V/` = `/Users/martin/claude/inspector-rust/vendor/openscreen-compositor/` (vendored compositor = upstream `crates/compositor` + patches)
- `C/` = `<scratchpad>/openscreen-src/new/` (untrusted upstream clone, TS side)
- `IR/` = `/Users/martin/claude/inspector-rust/`

## 0. TL;DR

- **Everything visual is drawn by the compositor from Scene fields**: zoom envelope + spring + log-scale + chaining + auto-follow dead zone (`V/src/regions.rs`, `V/src/cursor.rs`), cursor sprite/size/smoothing/bounce/pinning/motion blur/auto-hide/click impact (`V/src/cursor.rs`, `V/src/frame_geometry.rs`), padding/radius/shadow/bg blur/motion blur, wallpaper motion (shader modes 5/6), window chrome (mode 14) and modelled devices (mode 17) — all procedural, no image assets for frames.
- **TS does only data prep**: the **auto-zoom planner** (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/timeline/zoom-suggestions.ts`, 422 LOC, pure, fully portable — §2), depth→scale table, wallpaper string → background enum, cursor theme → absolute sprite paths (Electron main), click-sound hit placement, output dims, and the **layout rect** (`computeCompositeLayout`: padding/frame room) which stage 2 does not send.
- **Cfg flags do NOT need to change** for zoom/motion blur when a Scene is set: `cfg.zoom`/`cfg.layout_anim` only drive the fixture `timeline()` (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:1486-1510`); with a scene, zoom comes from `zoomRegions`, screen motion blur from `effects.motionBlur` (`:3107-3112`). Keep our `export_cfg` (`IR/record-render/src/session.rs:517-524`).
- **Biggest gotchas**: (a) the compositor loads the cursor sidecar as **`<screenPath>.cursor.json`** (`V/src/timeline_walk.rs:498`, `V/src/live.rs:179,1527,1751`) — we write `cursor.json`; (b) **LiveView ignores most scene effect/cursor values** and uses inspector params set via `set_param_*` (only `cursor.show/autoHide` are synced from `set_scene`, `V/src/live.rs:1195-1201`) — our helper never calls `set_param_*`, so preview ≠ export once effects are on; (c) wallpapers have no licence — don't ship; cursors (OpenScreen original art, MIT) and Kenney clicks (CC0) are shippable.

## 1. Scene fields: who computes what, exact serde shape, TS fill

All structs in `V/src/scene.rs`, `#[serde(rename_all="camelCase")]`, `Deserialize` only. TS fill = `buildSceneDescription` in `C/src/native/sceneDescription.ts:874-1701`; settings come from `getEditorSettings(document)` (`:878`), stored in the passthrough `legacyEditor` envelope (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/schema/index.ts:715,779`), defaults §7.

### 1a. `effects: SceneEffects` (`V/src/scene.rs:290-330`) — required
| field | type | serde | range / meaning | TS fill (`sceneDescription.ts`) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `padding` | f32 | required | 0..1; native `padding_scale = 1 − padding·0.4` (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:3242`) | `settings.padding / 100` (:1487), slider 0..100 |
| `blur` | f32 | required, `deserialize_with = blur_amount` (`:277-288`): bool true→0.5, false→0, number clamped 0..1 | background blur strength | `settings.backgroundBlur` (:1488) |
| `shadow` | f32 | required | 0..1 opacity scale (`opacity = 0.45·shadow_scale`, `V/src/compositor_macos.rs:2840`) | `settings.shadowIntensity` (:1489) |
| `roundnessFrac` | f32 | required | fraction | `padding>0 \|\| frame!="none" ? borderRadius / ROUNDNESS_REFERENCE_PX(1080) : 0` (:1497-1500; `C/src/native/paramUnits.ts:26`) |
| `motionBlur` | f32 | required | 0..1 → taps `1 + mb·15` (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:3107-3112`) | `settings.motionBlurAmount` (:1501) |
| `frame` | `SceneFrame` | `#[serde(default)]` = None | kebab-case enum `window\|laptop\|phone\|monitor\|window-light\|window-dark\|none(other)` (`:339-361`); `is_device()` laptop/phone/monitor (`:377`) | emitted only if `frame != "none"` (:1504) |
| `frameTheme` | `SceneFrameTheme` | `#[serde(default)]` = Light | `light\|dark(other)` (`:364-373`) | emitted only if frame on and theme != light (:1505-1507) |
| `depthOfField` | bool | default **true** (`:328-334`) | only on tilted (stage 7) | `settings.depthOfField` (:1508) |
Stage 2 sends all 0 + `depthOfField:false` (`IR/core/rust-lib/src/record/scene_json.rs:77-84`).

### 1b. `background: SceneBackground` (`V/src/scene.rs:399-423`) — required, `#[serde(tag="kind", rename_all="lowercase")]`
- `color { color: String }` ("#rrggbb")
- `gradient { angleDeg: f32, stops: Vec<String>, offsets: Vec<f32> (default [] → evenly spaced), motion: WallpaperMotion (default None) }`
- `image { path: String, motion: WallpaperMotion (default None) }` — `path` absolute file or `data:…;base64,` (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:83-95`, used at `V/src/compositor_macos.rs:1346-1351`). **Always cover-fit on the output ratio** (`V/src/compositor_macos.rs:1456`); no fit option.
- `WallpaperMotion` lowercase `drift|aurora|waves|none(other)` (`V/src/scene.rs:430-440`). Implemented in shader modes 5 (gradient) / 6 (image) via `wallpaper_motion_slots` (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:1716-1732`; index drift 1, aurora 2, waves 3; time wraps at `WALLPAPER_MOTION_PERIOD_S = 120.0` `:1658`; `mb.x` = fill-rect aspect). A moving background disables the background cache (`:1678-1691`).
- TS: `parseWallpaper(settings.wallpaper)` (`sceneDescription.ts:637-657`): `#…`→color; `linear-gradient(`→gradient via `parseCssGradient` + `resolveLinearGradientAngle` (stops = colours, offsets = CSS offsets); else image. `sceneBackground` attaches `motion` only if `motion != "none"` and kind is gradient or image (`:673-679`, `wallpaperAcceptsMotion :666`). Electron rewrites a leading-`/` image path to an absolute bundled path (`C/electron/native-bridge/services/compositorViewService.ts:175-191`).
- Stage 2 sends `{"kind":"color","color":"#000000"}` (`scene_json.rs:85`).

### 1c. `zoomRegions: Vec<SceneZoomRegion>` (`V/src/scene.rs:580-621`) — required (may be [])
| field | type | serde |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | String | default "" |
| `clipIndex` | Option<usize> | default None (falls back to source-window overlap, `:1011-1016`) |
| `startSec`, `endSec` | f64 | required — **source seconds of `clips[clipIndex]`** |
| `scale` | f32 | required, >1 zooms in |
| `focusX`, `focusY` | f32 | required, 0..1 of the (cropped) screen |
| `focusMode` | Option<String> | "manual" \| "auto" (follows cursor) \| null=manual |
| `rotation` | Option<String> | missing → None; "left"/"iso"/"right" fixed tilt, "orbit" — **stage 7, send null** |
| `underTrim` | bool | default false — region entirely under a trim: no ramps, no chaining (`V/src/regions.rs:426-428,804-814`) |
| `hideCursor` | bool | default false — fades cursor with the zoom (`V/src/regions.rs:447-511`) |
TS fill (`sceneDescription.ts:1531-1568`): regions projected raw-timeline→source per clip (`projectRegionsToSource`, :1110-1115); `scale = min(getZoomScale(region), zoomLimitByClip[clipIndex])` (`effectiveZoomScale` = customScale clamped [1,5] else depth table, `C/src/lib/ai-edition/timeline/zoom-scale.ts:54-60`; limit `maxZoomScaleFor` `:89-93` with `MAX_SOURCE_MAGNIFICATION=2`, ref 1080 px, computed from screenRect `sceneDescription.ts:768-783` — MAX if no screenRect); `focusX/Y = region.focus.cx/cy`; `focusMode = settings.autoFocusAll ? "auto" : (region.focusMode ?? null)` (:1563); `rotation = region.rotationPreset ?? null`; `underTrim`/`hideCursor` only when true.

### 1d. `cursor: SceneCursor` (`V/src/scene.rs:723-761`) — required
| field | type | serde | used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `show` | bool | required | draw gate (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:3790`); track loads regardless (auto-follow) `V/src/timeline_walk.rs:336-341` |
| `autoHide` | bool | default false | `CursorTrack::opacity_at` |
| `size` | f32 | required | `CURSOR_BASE_SIZE_FRAC(34/1080)·screen_unit·size·bounce·padding_scale` (`frame_geometry.rs:461,4008`) |
| `smoothing` | f32 | required | `CursorTrack::smoothed(factor)` 0..1 (export `timeline_walk.rs:342,500`) |
| `motionBlur` | f32 | required | cursor-only blur 0..1 (`frame_geometry.rs:4029`) |
| `clickBounce` | f32 | required | bounce amplitude multiplier (`:4005`) |
| `model3d` | bool | default false | stage 7 → false |
| `clickImpact` | bool | default false | screen recoil on clicks (`frame_geometry.rs:3434-3439`, `regions.rs:1535-1623`) |
| `clipToBounds` | bool | required | TS always false (:1522) |
| `theme` | String | required | informational; native reads `cursorSprites` |
| `cursorSprites` | HashMap<String, SceneCursorSprite> | default {} — empty ⇒ math dot+ring fallback (`:750-760`) |
`SceneCursorSprite { path: String (absolute PNG/JPEG), hotspotX: f32, hotspotY: f32 (FRACTIONS of the image), sculpt: Option<String>, glass: Option<String> }` (`:763-784`). Keys = state names `arrow,text,pointer,crosshair,open-hand,closed-hand,resize-ew,resize-ns,resize-nesw,resize-nwse,move,not-allowed,wait,app-starting,help,up-arrow` (`C/src/native/contracts.ts:8-24`).
TS fill (`sceneDescription.ts:1510-1524`): `show=settings.cursorShow, autoHide=settings.cursorAutoHide, size/smoothing/motionBlur/clickBounce/model3d/asArrow=settings.cursor.*, clickImpact: true only if on, clipToBounds:false, theme=settings.cursorTheme`. `cursorSprites` added in Electron main by `resolveCursorSprites(theme, asArrow, model3d)` → absolute paths (`compositorViewService.ts:128-147,193-199`; `C/src/lib/cursor/cursorThemes.ts` `resolveCursorSprites`: start from `DEFAULT_CURSOR_SPRITES`, overlay theme assets with `hotspot = hotspotXY / width|height`, then every kind in `asArrow` takes the arrow sprite via `CURSOR_KINDS`). `asArrow` is a TS-only extra key (ignored by serde).

### 1e. `output: SceneOutput { width: u32, height: u32, fps: Option<f64> }` (`V/src/scene.rs:892-899`) — see §6.

### 1f. `clickSound: SceneClickSound` (`V/src/scene.rs:855-886`) — `#[serde(default)]`
`{ downPath: String (default ""), upPath: String (default ""), hits: Vec<SceneClickHit> }`, `SceneClickHit { timeSec: f64 (OUTPUT programme seconds), gain: f32 (default 1.0), release: bool (default false) }`. Mixed by `audio::mix_click_hits` (`V/src/audio.rs:2021-2046`, skipped if any path empty, no hits, or programme PCM empty; `decode_click_hit` decodes `CLICK_HIT_WINDOW_SEC`), called at `V/src/pipeline_macos.rs:1449`. **Export only — LiveView has no audio**; OpenScreen plays cues in the renderer.
TS cue builder `buildClickCues` (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/clickSound.ts:62-99`): for `click|double-click|right-click|middle-click`: press at timeMs gain 1 (side clicks 0.85); double-click adds a 2nd press at +`DOUBLE_TAP_MS=90`; release = first `mouseup` in `(t, t+MAX_RELEASE_GAP_MS=600]` else `t+FALLBACK_RELEASE_MS=110`, gain×0.7, `release:true` (consts `:23-26`). Level `audioGainScalar(gainDb)=10^(dB/20)` (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/store/editorSettings.ts:64-66`). Hits projected through trims + speed onto the programme (`clickPlacement`, `clickSound.ts:252ff`). Emitted only when `cursorShow && cursor.clickSound` and hits exist (`sceneDescription.ts:919-922,1529`).

### 1g. Layout (not in spec list, but required for padding/frames to be correct)
`layout.screenRect` / `layoutByClip[i].screenRect` (`V/src/scene.rs:83-91,117-130,164-176`) are app-resolved rects that already include padding and **frame room**. Without them native falls back to `preset_placements` + `padding_scale` (`V/src/frame_geometry.rs:3237-3245`), which knows nothing about frame insets. TS computes them with `computeCompositeLayout` (`C/src/lib/compositeLayout.ts:447`), `paddedContentSize` (`:397-407`, fit = `1 − pad/100·0.4`, `paddingFit :385-387`), `frameFootprint` (`C/src/lib/frameFootprint.ts`, mirrors `V/src/frame_geometry.rs:488-492,637-757`). Port the no-webcam branch to Rust if frames ship.

## 2. Auto-zoom planner (TS → port 1:1)

Files: `C/src/lib/ai-edition/timeline/zoom-suggestions.ts` (algorithm), `zoom-scale.ts` (depth table), `C/src/lib/zoomMath/constants.ts` (ramp), `apply-auto-zooms.ts` (doc glue), tests `zoom-suggestions.test.ts`, `apply-auto-zooms.test.ts`. Pure, no DOM/IPC.

### 2a. Constants (`zoom-suggestions.ts:20-42`)
`OPENING_WIDE_MS=2500`, `CLOSING_WIDE_MS=1000`, `STOP_CLICK_GUARD_MS=1000`, `SHOT_MERGE_GAP_MS=3000`, `SHOT_LEAD_MS=500`, `SHOT_TAIL_MS=1500`, `MIN_SHOT_HOLD_MS=1800`, `MIN_WIDE_BETWEEN_MS=1500`, `SHOT_FIT_MARGIN=0.12`, `SHOT_DEPTHS=[1,2,3]` (planner only uses 1.25/1.5/1.8). In `detectClicks`: `UNRELEASED_PRESS_GRACE_MS=150` (:103).
Depths (`zoom-scale.ts:23-35`): **1→1.25, 2→1.5, 3→1.8, 4→2.2, 5→3.5, 6→5.0**; `MIN_ZOOM_SCALE=1.0`, `MAX_ZOOM_SCALE=5.0`, `DEFAULT_ZOOM_DEPTH=3`. `zoomLevelFor(scale)`: exact table value → depth else customScale (:67-72).
Ramp: `zoomTransitionMs(scale) = 600 + 550·ln(max(1,scale))` (`constants.ts:7-12`) = compositor `zoom_transition_s` (`V/src/regions.rs:326-327,408-410`).

### 2b. Inputs
Cursor sidecar samples `{timeMs, cx, cy, visible?, interactionType?}` (`C/src/components/video-editor/types.ts:262-278`). Normalize (`:58-82`): drop non-finite, sort by time, clamp timeMs to [0,total], cx/cy to [0,1].
`detectClicks` (`:97-135`): click types = `click|double-click|right-click|middle-click` (`:90-91`). Walk samples: on a click sample → `finishPress(false)`, then `pending = visible===false ? null : sample`; on `mouseup` → `finishPress(true)`; else if pending and `visible===false` and no `hiddenAt` → `hiddenAt = timeMs`. `finishPress(released)`: drop the press if `hiddenAt !== null && (released || hiddenAt − press.timeMs ≤ 150)`; else emit `{timeMs, focus:{cx,cy}}` of the press sample. Final `finishPress(false)`.
`visibleClicks` also drops clicks with `timeMs ≥ ignoreFromMs` (stop click).

### 2c. Algorithm
1. `fitDepth(box)` (`:188-195`): `size = max(w,h) + 2·0.12`; deepest depth d in [1,2,3] with `scale(d)·size ≤ 1`, else null.
2. `planShots(clicks, totalMs, wideUntil, wideFrom)` (`:203-246`): group consecutive clicks while `t − lastTimeInGroup ≤ 3000` AND the union box still fits (else start new group). Per group: `depth = fitDepth(box) ?? 1`; `ramp = zoomTransitionMs(scale)`; `earliest = max(0, ceil(wideUntil + ramp))`; `latest = min(total, floor(wideFrom − ramp))`; `start = max(min(round(first − 500), latest − 1800), earliest)`; `end = min(max(round(last + 1500), start + 1800), latest)`; drop if `end − start < 1800` or no click lies in `[start,end]`.
3. `resolveShots(shots, reserved)` (`:257-317`, loop until no clash): spans = planned shots + reserved existing zooms (`scale ?? 1.8`), sorted by start; `outOf(span) = end + zoomTransitionMs(scale)`; track `reach` = earlier span with latest `outOf`; for each span (if reach or span is a planned shot): `wide = span.start − outOf(reach) − zoomTransitionMs(span.scale)`; if `wide < 1500` → clash. Resolution: both planned → if same clip and `fitDepth(union)` non-null → merge `{start:a.start, end:max(a.end,b.end), depth, box:union, clicks:a+b}`; else drop the one with fewer clicks (tie → drop later `b`, since `a.clicks >= b.clicks ? b : a`); planned vs reserved → drop the planned one (reserved never move).
4. Output (`toSuggestion :319-325`): `{span:{start,end} (ms), focus:{cx:(minX+maxX)/2, cy:(minY+maxY)/2}, depth}`, sorted by start.
Entry points: `buildAutoZoomSuggestions({cursorTelemetry,totalMs,existingRegions,wideUntilMs?,wideFromMs?,ignoreClicksFromMs?})` (`:335-353`, bounds default ±∞); `buildAutoZoomSuggestionsForClips` (`:378-422`): per clip, samples in source window `[sourceStart, sourceStart+window]` shifted to clip-local; `ignoreFrom = lastSampleMs(all telemetry) − 1000 − sourceOffset`; `wideUntil = editStart + 2500 − timelineOffset`; `wideFrom = editEnd − 1000 − timelineOffset`; shots shifted by timelineOffset, tagged `clip`; then one global `resolveShots`.
Writing to doc (`apply-auto-zooms.ts:99-125`): `{id, startMs:round, endMs:round, depth, focus, focusMode:"auto"}` anchored per clip. Existing regions passed with `scale: effectiveZoomScale(region)` (`:40-44`).

### 2d. Manual zooms (doc + scene)
Doc schema `zoomRegionSchema` (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/schema/index.ts:498-533`): `id`, `startMs`, `endMs` (raw timeline ms, end≥start), clip anchor fields, `depth: 1..6`, `focus:{cx,cy ∈[0,1]}`, `focusMode?: "manual"|"auto"`, `rotationPreset?` (stage 7), `customScale?>0`, `source?: "auto"|"manual"`, `hideCursor?`. New manual zoom (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/store/useTimeline.ts:403-431`): duration `DEFAULT_NEW_REGION_SEC=2` (:89; UI uses pill-width rule `PILL_CREATE_PX=96`, min 0.25 s, `newRegionDuration.ts:36-63`), `depth:3`, `focus:{0.5,0.5}`, **`focusMode:"auto"`**. No separate "follow cursor" or "pinning" fields: follow = `focusMode:"auto"`; pinning is cursor-side (§3). Scene mapping §1c.

### 2e. Where the motion math lives (compositor, authoritative)
`V/src/regions.rs`: `TRANSITION_WINDOW_S=1.01505`, `ZOOM_TRANSITION_BASE_S=0.6`, `ZOOM_TRANSITION_PER_LN_S=0.55`, `SPRING_OMEGA_T=7.0`, `CHAINED_ZOOM_PAN_GAP_S=1.5`, `CONNECTED_ZOOM_PAN_DURATION_S=1.0` (:322-333). `ease_spring(t) = (1 − (1+x)e^−x)/(1 − (1+7)e^−7)`, x=7·clamp(t) (:398-402). `scale_lerp(a,b,t)=a·(b/a)^t` (log, :390-393). Strength: ease-in over `[start−window, start]`, 1 on span, ease-out after end; measured on `ScreenClock` (speed-mapped) (:423-441). Chaining: sort by start, gap `≤1.5 s` (screen) → pair, pan over 1.0 s from first end with `ease_connected_pan = cubic-bezier(0.1,0,0.2,1)` (:632-634, 808-836), then hold on next until its start. Dominant independent region = max strength, ties → later start (:991-1013). Focus easing: `f − (f−0.5)(1−s)/scale` (:1027). `zoom_state_in` :892-1043; `resolve_focus` :763-795 (auto ⇒ `track.follow_in_view(t0 = start − window, t, t_end = end + window, scale)`).
Auto-follow (`V/src/cursor.rs`): `AUTO_FOLLOW_MIN_FACTOR=0.1`, `MAX=0.25`, `RAMP_DISTANCE=0.15`, `REFERENCE_MS=25` (:10-13); `follow_step` factor `1 − (1−base)^(dt/25)`, base lerps by distance/0.15 (:124-131); presmoothed `follow_samples` (:99-120). Dead zone `FOLLOW_DEAD_ZONE=0.5` of the half-view `0.5/scale` (:18, 275-355), view clamped to `[half, 1−half]`, cache 32 regions.
Tests pinning behaviour: TS `zoom-suggestions.test.ts` — click selection (`:30-141`: hidden click ignored; visible press with hide during drag ignored; release before later hide kept; legacy click without mouseup kept if hide much later, rejected if hide next tick; tap folded with release kept; hidden mouseup sample kept; all four click kinds accepted; move/mouseup not clicks; no zoom for parked pointer; empty→nothing), shots (`:149-265`: click@2000 in 0..5000 → {1500,3500}, depth 3, focus = click; burst 2000/3500/5000 → {1500,6500} depth 3 focus (0.35,0.325); spread 0.35 → depth 2, 0.5 → depth 1; clash keeps more clicks → {1500,4100}; 4 s gap same spot merges {1500,7500}; wide shot kept {1500,3500},{8500,10500}; reserved zoom 3000-5000 blocks click@7000, allows @9000; overlapping reserved; 5× reserved ramps; ends of axis {0,1800} and {3200,5000}), clips (`:267-490`: click per replaying clip, source in-point shift, outside window ignored, reserve per clip, telemetry-less clips skipped, unprobed clip skipped, single click after trim, no hold across cut, opening/ending wide, stop click ignored). `apply-auto-zooms.test.ts:54-197` (telemetry on asset path, one-pass planning across takes, anchoring, retry when clips move). Compositor: `regions.rs` tests `:1738-3699` (e.g. `a_zoom_moves_at_a_comfortable_pace_at_every_level :1972`, `manual_focus_travels_to_centre_linearly_during_the_ramp :1943`, `a_region_under_a_trim_* :2028/2041`, `a_speed_region_scales_the_footage_not_the_camera_move :2105`, `zoom_cursor_alpha_* :1847-1911`, `auto_focus_* :1791/1820`), `cursor.rs` tests `:680-1124`.

## 3. Cursor

### 3a. Sidecar the compositor reads (`V/src/cursor.rs:191-257`)
Path: **`format!("{screenPath}.cursor.json")`** (export `V/src/timeline_walk.rs:498`; live `V/src/live.rs:179,1527,1751`; `LiveView::create(..., cursor_json)` arg :1008/1596 — we pass `""`, `IR/record-render/src/session.rs:351`). Parsed as untyped JSON: top-level `samples[]` required; per sample `timeMs` (f64, missing→−1 → skipped), `cx`,`cy` (missing→0), `visible` (bool, missing→true), `interactionType` (**only `"click"`** counts as a click, and only if visible, :230), `cursorType` (string; null/absent/"" → `"arrow"`, only transitions kept, :239-248). `provider`, `version`, `assets`, `assetId` are ignored. Loaded with offset 0, window 24 h, then `smoothed(scene.cursor.smoothing)`.
Planner (TS) additionally uses `double-click/right-click/middle-click` and `mouseup` (§2b, §1f).

### 3b. Our stage-1 format vs that (`IR/core/rust-lib/src/record/project.rs:87-148`, `core.rs:244-262`, `cursor_macos.rs`)
Field names match (`CursorRecording {version, provider, samples, assets}`, `CursorSample {timeMs, cx, cy, visible?, assetId?, cursorType?, interactionType?}`, `CursorAsset`). Mismatches:
1. **File name**: ours `cursor.json` (`project.rs:10`) next to `screen.mp4`; compositor wants `screen.mp4.cursor.json`. Fix: write/symlink/copy at open, or pass the path (live create arg only covers the first load; `set_active_clip` reloads by `{screen}.cursor.json`, `live.rs:1751-1754`).
2. **Double-click second press** is written as `"double-click"` (`cursor_macos.rs:88-99`, click_count≥2): compositor ignores it → no bounce/pin/impact on that press; planner/click sound do count it. Same as upstream semantics, but noteworthy. Right/middle clicks likewise don't bounce.
3. `provider: "position-only"` is our extension (`project.rs:89-94`); TS union is `"native"|"none"` (`C/src/native/contracts.ts:7`). Harmless for the compositor; our Rust planner must accept it.
4. We emit explicit `interactionType:"move"` on ticks (`cursor_macos.rs:698`) — fine (ignored).
5. `cx/cy` not clamped (`core.rs:228-240`) — compositor doesn't clamp, planner clamps; fine.
6. Late clicks are retimed +1 ms as own samples (`cursor_macos.rs:53-86`) — fine.
7. Visibility: we emit `visible:false` after 3 outside samples (`core.rs:212-226`) — compatible (hidden clicks dropped).
8. `assets` (system cursor images as data URLs) unused by the compositor — themed sprites are used instead.

### 3c. Cursor behaviour constants (compositor)
- Spring path smoothing `smoothed()` (`cursor.rs:472-546`): resample 240 Hz (`STEP_S=1/240`), semi-implicit Euler; spring per hidden/visible run; `cursor_spring_config` (`:657-669`): f≤0 → (k=1000,c=100,m=1); f≤0.5 → n=f/0.5: (760−420n, 34+24n, 0.55+0.45n); else n=(f−0.5)/1.5: (340−180n, 58+22n, 1+0.35n).
- Click bounce (`:428-446`): `ANIM_S=0.26`, `PRESS_FRAC=0.38`; press `1 − 0.24·sin(πe/0.38)`, rebound `1 + 0.16·sin(π(e−0.38)/0.62)`; last click only; amplitude scaled by `clickBounce` (`frame_geometry.rs:4005`).
- Click pinning `pinned_at` (`:375-404`): `PIN_APPROACH_S=0.25`, `PIN_HOLD_S=0.1`, `PIN_RELEASE_S=0.25` (:22-24), smoothstep weights to the raw click point; used for flat and 3D (`frame_geometry.rs:3891-3896`).
- Auto-hide `opacity_at` (`:554-627`): `IDLE_TIMEOUT_S=1.5`, `FADE_DURATION_S=0.3`, `MOVE_THRESH_SQ=0.015²`, fresh-move test 0.005² within 0.1 s.
- Cursor alpha = idle × `zoom_cursor_alpha` (hideCursor) (`frame_geometry.rs:3785-3802`).
- Click impact (`regions.rs:1535-1623`): `CLICK_IMPACT_WINDOW_S=0.26`, `CLICK_IMPACT_DEG=1.9`, `TAP_NORM=0.610`, `tap(e) = −sin(2πe)(1−e)²/0.610`; gated by cursor alpha, speed weight `clamp(2−speed,0,1)`, blur masks, clip window (`frame_geometry.rs:3829-3857`). On a flat screen it is a recoil/scale-down (`:3440-3445`).
- Size base `CURSOR_BASE_SIZE_FRAC = 34/1080` (`frame_geometry.rs:461`).

### 3d. Themes / assets / licences
7 themes = `default` + `studio-ink, prism-glow, pop-coral, pixel-candy, star-sprout, glass-lens` (`C/src/lib/cursor/cursorThemes.ts:152-…`, ids set `CURSOR_THEME_IDS`). Files `C/public/cursors/default/*.png` (16 states, hotspots in `DEFAULT_CURSOR_SPRITES :73-97`, fractions) and `C/public/cursors/<theme>/{arrow,pointer}.png` (hotspots in a 32-unit reference → divide by width/height). Licence: "These six packs are original OpenScreen artwork" (`cursorThemes.ts` comment above `CURSOR_THEMES`) → MIT with the repo; Sweezy packs were removed for licence reasons. Default sprites already vendored under `V/fixtures/upstream/public/cursors/default/` (VENDORED.md patch 6). `sculpt`/`glass` (studio-ink/prism-glow/glass-lens 3D/glass) are stage 7 except **glass-lens draws as glass even with 3D off** (`glass` key, mode 19) — include or drop that theme deliberately. `asArrow` default and `CURSOR_KINDS` grouping (`cursorThemes.ts:105-145`). "Custom cursors": no user-upload feature exists for the compositor path (`uploadedCursorAssets.ts` is the legacy web renderer's SVG trim table); a custom cursor = our own `cursorSprites` map (path + fractional hotspot).
Click sounds: `C/public/sounds/click-down.wav` (Kenney `click3.wav`), `click-up.wav` (`switch12.wav`), trimmed, 0.7 peak; **CC0 1.0** (`C/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md:253-263`).

## 5. Device frames
All procedural in the compositor: window chrome = shader mode 14 (title bar `WINDOW_FRAME_BAR_FRAC=0.04`, line `0.0012`, traffic lights; `V/src/frame_geometry.rs:485-492`, `V/src/shaders.metal:426`), devices laptop/phone/monitor = mode 17 3D model (`shaders.metal:2912`, constants `frame_geometry.rs:637-757`: bezels laptop 0.0356/0.0409, monitor 0.0178, phone 0.014, rim 0.0053, deck/hinge/stand dims). Theme light/dark per `frameTheme`. Only `include_str!` is the shader source — **no image assets**, licence = OpenScreen MIT. Device frame look relies on 3D shading but is not "3D frames" in the stage-7 tilt sense; it's drawn flat-on at rest (`DEVICE_FRAMES`, `C/src/lib/projectDefaults.ts:29-33`). Layout room for frames comes from TS (`frameFootprint.ts`) — see §1g.

## 6. Output aspect ratio
Presets `ASPECT_RATIO_PRESETS = ["16:9","9:16","1:1","4:3","4:5","16:10","10:16"]` (`C/src/utils/aspectRatioUtils.ts:2-10`), plus `"auto"`, `"native"` and arbitrary `"W:H"` (:29). Default `"auto"` (`projectDefaults.ts:243`). `pickOutputDims` (`C/src/lib/ai-edition/document/outputFormat.ts:402-414`): reference = largest effective (crop-applied) clip dims (fallback 1920×1080); `longSide = toEvenPx(max(w,h))`; ratio≥1 → `(longSide, even(longSide/ratio))` else `(even(longSide·ratio), longSide)`; `toEvenPx = max(2, round(v/2)·2)` (:54). `auto` = `autoFormatAspect(screen, preset, frame, padding)` (`C/src/lib/compositeLayout.ts:432-445`: `autoFrameAspect(restingCompositionAspect)` where elongation `e' = fit·e + (1−fit)`, fit=`1−pad/100·0.4`; with a frame, 8 fixed-point passes). `native` = reference clip ratio. Scene: `output: {...pickOutputDims(document, settings.aspectRatio), fps: null}` (`sceneDescription.ts:1688`). Ours: `Aspect` enum source/16:9/9:16/1:1/4:3/3:4/21:9 + `output_size(meta, aspect, target 720/1080/source)` (`IR/core/rust-lib/src/record/editor.rs:50-83,400-410`) — differs from upstream (no 4:5/16:10/10:16/auto; ours has 3:4/21:9; upstream sizes from the long side of the source, ours from 720/1080 targets).

## 9. Cfg flags
`Cfg { composite, rounded, shadow, bg_blur, zoom, layout_anim, cursor, mblur_n }` (`V/src/config.rs:4-16`), C8 = all on with `mblur_n=8` (:57). With a Scene: zoom regions are sampled unconditionally (`frame_geometry.rs:3114-3120,3177,3188`); `cfg.zoom/layout_anim` only affect the fixture timeline (`:1486-1510`) and both upstream export (`N/…export_cfg_and_scene`) and live (`V/src/live.rs:1632-1633`) keep them **false**. Screen motion blur comes from `effects.motionBlur` when a scene is set (`:3107-3112`); cursor blur from live params. `cfg.cursor` is overridden by `scene.cursor.show` (`:3790`). `cfg.shadow` (C3+) gates shadow drawing, opacity from live `shadow_scale` (`compositor_macos.rs:2837-2840`); `cfg.rounded` gates corner radius (`frame_geometry.rs:3584`). **Our `export_cfg` (`session.rs:517-524`) is already correct** (C8, zoom/layout_anim off, mblur_n 1, bg_blur from scene, cursor from show). Nothing to switch on.
LiveView, however: `cfg.bg_blur = ip.bg_blur`, `cfg.mblur_n = ip.mblur_taps`, `cfg.cursor = ip.cursor_show` (`live.rs:1783-1785`) and `set_live_params` from inspector params (`:1797-1811`); defaults `bg_blur 0, shadow_scale 1.0, radius_scale 1.0, mblur_taps 8, padding 0, cursor_size 1.0, bounce 1.0, smoothing 0, cursor_motion_blur 0, autoHide false` (`:802-822`). `set_scene` syncs only `cursor_show/auto_hide` (`:1195-1201`). Upstream pushes every param after the scene (`pushAllNativeParams`, `C/src/native/nativeCompositorStore.ts:129-152`: backgroundBlur, motionBlur, shadow, `roundness = borderRadius/24`, `padding = padding/100`, backgroundColor (only `#…`), webcam*, cursorShow, cursorAutoHide, cursorSize, cursorClickBounce, cursorModel3d, cursorSmoothing, cursorMotionBlur). Export instead derives `LiveParams` from the scene (`live_params_from_scene`, `frame_geometry.rs:1856-1875`).

## 10. Risks
1. **Sidecar path** (§3b-1): without `screen.mp4.cursor.json` the compositor silently renders no cursor and auto-focus zooms stay centred. No vendor patch needed (write/link the file), but a patch to accept an explicit path would also work.
2. **Live preview param drift** (§9): our helper must call `LiveView::set_param_num/bool` for padding, shadow, roundness, motionBlur, backgroundBlur, cursorSize/ClickBounce/Smoothing/MotionBlur/AutoHide/Show after each `set_scene`, mirroring `pushAllNativeParams` units. Already latent in stage 2: preview shadow_scale=1.0 vs scene 0 (screen fills the frame so invisible today).
3. **Layout rects** (§1g): padding works without `screenRect`, but frames need TS `computeCompositeLayout`/`frameFootprint`/`autoFormatAspect` ported to Rust (no-webcam branch), else chrome/devices may be clipped and Auto format can't be reproduced. Medium port (~compositeLayout.ts 773 LOC + frameFootprint.ts 143 LOC, only partly needed).
4. **Click sound in preview**: compositor live has no audio; we must schedule the two WAVs ourselves during preview playback (programme-time projection through trims+speed like `clickPlacement`). Export side is done by the compositor. `mix_click_hits` returns early on empty programme PCM (`audio.rs:2022-2027`).
5. **Time axes**: OpenScreen authors zooms in raw timeline ms and projects to source per clip (`projectRegionsToSource`); the planner runs per clip on source-time telemetry. Our `EditDoc` (source-ms clips + `clip` index, like `speed`) can store zooms directly in source ms + `clipIndex`; the planner's opening/closing/stop guards must be mapped to our programme. Planner's `MIN_WIDE_BETWEEN_MS` is measured in timeline ms, not the speed-mapped screen clock (upstream "ponytail" note `zoom-suggestions.ts:253-255`).
6. **Assets/licences**: wallpapers unlicensed → don't ship (need our own images / motion gradients); cursor PNGs MIT (OpenScreen original) — copy `public/cursors/**` (≈ 16 + 12 PNG) with THIRD-PARTY notice; Kenney WAVs CC0. Recordly MIT notice already kept (VENDORED.md). Glass-lens theme uses `glass` mode 19 even flat — verify it renders or exclude.
7. **Double-click/right-click** don't trigger compositor bounce/impact/pin (only `"click"`), while the planner/click sound count them — matches upstream; decide whether to also emit a `"click"` for the 2nd press (would change click-sound double counting).
8. **Zoom scale limit**: `zoomLimitByClip` needs screenRect + source dims; without screenRect it's always 5×.
9. **Stage-7 leakage**: keep `rotation: null`, `model3d:false`, no `sculpt`; `depthOfField` default true is inert without tilt (stage 2 sends false — fine). `clickImpact` on a flat screen is a recoil (not 3D) — allowed in stage 3.
10. **Scene schema drift**: `rotation` has no `#[serde(default)]` but is `Option` → missing is OK. Pin a golden scene JSON for the stage-3 fields (extend `IR/core/rust-lib/src/record/fixtures/scene-golden.json`).
11. No vendor patch is strictly required for this scope; optional patches: explicit cursor sidecar path in `LiveView::set_active_clip`/`timeline_walk`, and accepting `"double-click"` as a click in `CursorTrack::load` (`cursor.rs:230`).
